title: One Volcano Blasted Ash 36 Miles Into the Sky

scenes.text: One volcano blasted ash 36 miles into the sky.
In January 2022, Tonga's underwater volcano exploded.
Its plume reached the mesosphere, the first volcanic plume ever recorded to get that high.
That's about two and a half times higher than any thunderstorm ever observed.
The blast sent a pressure wave around the whole planet for days. People heard the boom as far away as Alaska.
Ash, 36 miles straight up. More than halfway to space.

description:
One volcano blasted ash 36 miles into the sky.
The 2022 Hunga Tonga eruption made the highest volcanic plume ever recorded.
Its pressure wave circled the Earth for several days.
Did you know a single volcano could do this?
first_comment: Would you have wanted to watch this eruption from space?
